CAST(sig.controlled_file_id AS CHAR)) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_code, CONVERT(COALESCE(file.title, file.file_name, CONCAT('文件ID ', sig.controlled_file_id)) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_name, sig.actor_id AS signer_user_id, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.actor_nickname_snapshot, sig.actor_username_snapshot, CAST(sig.actor_id AS CHAR)) USING utf8mb4) AS signer_name, CONVERT(sig.actor_username_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_username_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_nickname_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_nickname_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_dept_name_snapshot USING actor_role_names_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.action_type USING utf8mb4) AS action_code, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.meaning_label, sig.action_type) USING utf8mb4) AS action_label, CONVERT(sig.meaning_code USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_code, CONVERT(sig.meaning_label USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_label, CONVERT(sig.comment USING utf8mb4) AS comment, sig.signed_at AS signed_at, CONVERT(sig.evidence_hash USING utf8mb4) sig.signature_image_file_id AS signature_image_file_id, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_file_url USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_file_url, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_sha256 USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_sha256, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_content_type USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_content_type, sig.signature_image_file_size AS signature_image_file_size, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_status_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_status_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_verified_status USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_verified_status, CONVERT('DccControlledFileDetail' USING utf8mb4) AS detail_route_name, CONVERT(CONCAT('/dcc/controlled-file/detail/', sig.controlled_file_id, '?viewer=1&from=signature-governance') USING utf8mb4) AS detail_path FROM dcc_controlled_file_signature sig LEFT JOIN dcc_controlled_file file ON file.id = sig.controlled_file_id AND file.deleted = b'0' WHERE sig.deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(CONCAT('BATCH_RECORD-', sig.id) USING utf8mb4) AS global_id, CONVERT('BATCH_RECORD' USING utf8mb4) AS source_code, CONVERT('批记录' USING utf8mb4) AS source_label, CONVERT('mes_pro_batch_record_execution_signature' USING utf8mb4) AS source_table, sig.id AS source_record_id, sig.execution_id AS business_record_id, CONVERT(COALESCE(execution.execution_code, CAST(sig.execution_id AS CHAR)) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_code, CONVERT(COALESCE(execution.template_name, execution.work_order_code, execution.batch_code, CONCAT('批记录执行ID ', sig.execution_id)) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_name, sig.actor_id AS signer_user_id, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.actor_name, sig.actor_nickname_snapshot, sig.actor_username_snapshot, CAST(sig.actor_id AS CHAR)) USING utf8mb4) AS signer_name, CONVERT(sig.actor_username_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_username_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_nickname_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_nickname_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_dept_name_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_dept_name_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_post_names_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_post_names_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.actor_role_names_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS actor_role_names_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.action_type USING utf8mb4) AS action_code, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.approval_result, sig.action_type) USING utf8mb4) AS action_label, CONVERT(sig.approval_result USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_code, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.approval_result, sig.reason, sig.action_type) USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_label, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.comment, sig.reason) USING utf8mb4) AS comment, sig.signed_at AS signed_at, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.signature_challenge_hash, sig.field_audit_head_hash, sig.cell_values_hash, execution.cell_values_hash, execution.domain_trace_hash) USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_hash, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.snapshot_status, execution.domain_trace_status) USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_status, NULL AS signature_image_id, NULL AS signature_image_version_no, NULL AS signature_image_file_id, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_file_url, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_sha256, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_content_type, NULL AS signature_image_file_size, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_status_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_verified_status, CONVERT('MesProFeedbackEdhrSignatures' USING utf8mb4) AS detail_route_name, CONVERT(CONCAT('/mes/pro/feedback/edhr-signatures?executionId=', sig.execution_id) USING utf8mb4) AS detail_path FROM mes_pro_batch_record_execution_signature sig LEFT JOIN mes_pro_batch_record_execution execution ON execution.id = sig.execution_id AND execution.deleted = b'0' WHERE sig.deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(CONCAT('SHOWROOM-', sig.id) USING utf8mb4) AS global_id, CONVERT('SHOWROOM' USING utf8mb4) AS source_code, CONVERT('展厅' USING utf8mb4) AS source_label, CONVERT('showroom_change_request_signature' USING utf8mb4) AS source_table, sig.id AS source_record_id, sig.change_request_id AS business_record_id, CONVERT(CONCAT('SHOWROOM-', sig.change_request_id) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_code, CONVERT(CONCAT_WS(' / ', request.module_code, request.request_type, request.status) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_name, sig.actor_id AS signer_user_id, CONVERT(CAST(sig.actor_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) AS signer_name, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_username_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_nickname_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_dept_name_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_post_names_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_role_names_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.action_type USING utf8mb4) AS action_code, CONVERT(sig.action_type USING utf8mb4) AS action_label, CONVERT(sig.approval_stage USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_code, CONVERT(sig.approval_stage USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_label, CONVERT(sig.comment USING utf8mb4) AS comment, sig.signed_at AS signed_at, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_hash, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_status, NULL AS signature_image_id, NULL AS signature_image_version_no, NULL AS signature_image_file_id, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_file_url, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_sha256, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_content_type, NULL AS signature_image_file_size, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_status_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_verified_status, CONVERT('ShowroomChangeRequestDetail' USING utf8mb4) AS detail_route_name, CONVERT(CONCAT('/showroom/change-request/detail?id=', sig.change_request_id) USING utf8mb4) AS detail_path FROM showroom_change_request_signature sig LEFT JOIN showroom_change_request request ON request.id = sig.change_request_id AND request.deleted = b'0' WHERE sig.deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(CONCAT(sig.module_code, '-', sig.id) USING utf8mb4) AS global_id, CONVERT(sig.module_code USING utf8mb4) AS source_code, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.module_code = 'BPM' THEN 'BPM审批' WHEN sig.module_code = 'MES_FEEDBACK' THEN '报工审批' ELSE sig.module_code END USING utf8mb4) AS source_label, CONVERT('bpm_approval_signature_record' USING utf8mb4) AS source_table, sig.id AS source_record_id, CASE WHEN sig.module_code = 'MES_FEEDBACK' AND sig.source_task_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(sig.source_task_id AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS business_record_id, CONVERT(COALESCE(sig.business_key, sig.process_instance_id, sig.source_task_id, CONCAT(sig.module_code, '-', sig.id)) USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_code, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.module_code = 'BPM' THEN CONCAT('BPM审批 ', COALESCE(sig.process_instance_id, sig.source_task_id, sig.business_key, sig.id)) WHEN sig.module_code = 'MES_FEEDBACK' THEN CONCAT('生产报工审批 ', COALESCE(sig.source_task_id, sig.business_key, sig.id)) ELSE CONCAT(sig.module_code, ' 审批') END USING utf8mb4) AS business_record_name, sig.signer_user_id AS signer_user_id, CONVERT(COALESCE(sys_user.nickname, CAST(sig.signer_user_id AS CHAR)) USING utf8mb4) AS signer_name, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_username_snapshot, CONVERT(sys_user.nickname USING utf8mb4) AS actor_nickname_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_dept_name_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_post_names_snapshot, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS actor_role_names_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.review_result USING utf8mb4) AS action_code, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.review_result = 'APPROVE' THEN '审批通过' WHEN sig.review_result = 'REJECT' THEN '审批驳回' ELSE sig.review_result END USING utf8mb4) AS action_label, CONVERT(sig.review_result USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_code, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.password_verified = b'1' THEN '电子签名密码已验证' ELSE '电子签名密码未验证' END USING utf8mb4) AS meaning_label, CONVERT(sig.reason USING utf8mb4) AS comment, sig.signed_at AS signed_at, CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_hash, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.password_verified = b'1' THEN 'PASSWORD_VERIFIED' ELSE 'PASSWORD_NOT_VERIFIED' END USING utf8mb4) AS evidence_status, sig.signature_image_id AS signature_image_id, sig.signature_image_version_no AS signature_image_version_no, sig.signature_image_file_id AS signature_image_file_id, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_file_url USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_file_url, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_sha256 USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_sha256, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_content_type USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_content_type, sig.signature_image_file_size AS signature_image_file_size, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_status_snapshot USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_status_snapshot, CONVERT(sig.signature_image_verified_status USING utf8mb4) AS signature_image_verified_status, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.module_code = 'BPM' THEN 'BpmProcessInstanceDetail' WHEN sig.module_code = 'MES_FEEDBACK' THEN 'MesProFeedback' ELSE NULL END USING utf8mb4) AS detail_route_name, CONVERT(CASE WHEN sig.module_code = 'BPM' THEN CONCAT('/bpm/process-instance/detail?id=', sig.process_instance_id, '&taskId=', sig.source_task_id) WHEN sig.module_code = 'MES_FEEDBACK' THEN CONCAT('/mes/pro/feedback?feedbackId=', sig.source_task_id) ELSE NULL END USING utf8mb4) AS detail_path FROM bpm_approval_signature_record sig LEFT JOIN system_users sys_user ON sys_user.id = sig.signer_user_id AND sys_user.deleted = b'0' WHERE sig.deleted = b'0' ) merged WHERE merged.global_id = #{globalId} LIMIT 1
